english_text: My Lord, my sins have silenced me, and my words have been cut off.

arabic_text: فَلاَ حُجَّةَ لِي، فَأَنَا الأَسِيـرُ بِبَلِيَّتِي، الْمُـرْتَهَنُ بِعَمَلِي، الْمُتَرَدِّدُ فِي خَطِيئَتِي، الْمُتَحَيِّرُ عَنْ قَصْدِي، الْمُنْقَطَعُ بِي،
transliteration: fala ḥujjata li, fa-ana al-'asīru bi-balīyatī al-murtahanu bi'amali, al-mutaraddidu fi khatiyyati al-mutahayyiru ʿan qasdī, al-munqaṭaʿu bī
english_text: I have no argument, for I am the prisoner of my own affliction, the hostage to my works, the frequenter of my own offense, the confused in my intended way, the thwarted.

arabic_text: قَدْ أَوْقَفْتُ نَفْسِي مَوْقِفَ الأَذِلاَّءِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ، مَوْقِفَ الأَشْقِيآءِ الْمُتَجَرِّينَ عَلَيْكَ، الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِوَعْدِكَ.
transliteration: qad awqaf tu nafsī mawqif al-'adhilā'i al-mudhnibīn mauqif al-ashqiyaa al-mutajarreena ʿalayka, al-mustakhiffina bi-waʿdika
english_text: I have brought myself to a halt in the halting place of the abased sinners, the halting place of the wretched and insolent, those who think lightly of Thy promise.
Glory be to Thee! What insolence I have insolently shown toward Thee!
What delusion with which I have deluded myself!

arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ إرْحَمْ كَبْوَتِيْ لِحُرِّ وَجْهِي، وَزَلَّةَ قَدَمِي، وَعُدْ بِحِلْمِكَ عَلَى جَهْلِي، وَبِإحْسَانِكَ عَلَى إسَآءَتِي، فَأَنَا الْمُقِرُّ بِذَنْبِي، الْمُعْتَرِفُ بِخَطِيئَتِي، وَهَذِهِ يَدِيْ وَنَاصِيَتِي،
transliteration: mawlāya irḥam kabwātī li-ḥurri wajhī wa-zallata qadami, wa'ud bi-hilmika 'ala jahli wa bi-iḥsānika ʿalā ʾisāʾatī, fa-anā al-muqirru bi-dhanbī al-muʿtarifu bi-khatīʾatī, wa-hādhīhi yadī wa-nāṣiyatī
english_text: My Master, have mercy on my falling flat on my face the slipping of my foot, grant me my ignorance through Thy clemency, and my evildoing through Thy beneficence, for I admit my sin and I confess my offense: Here are my hand and my forelock!
I am resigned to retaliation against my soul!

arabic_text: إرْحَمْ شَيْبَتِي، وَنَفَادَ أَيَّامِي، وَاقْتِرَابَ أَجَلِي، وَضَعْفِي، وَمَسْكَنَتِي، وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي.
transliteration: irḥam shaybatī, wa nafad 'ayyāmī, waqtirab ajali, wadhaʿfi wa maskanati, wa qillata heelati
english_text: Have mercy on my white hair, the depletion of my days, the nearing of my term, my frailty, my misery, and the paucity of my stratagems!

arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي إذَا انْقَطَعَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا أَثَرِي، وَامَّحى مِنَ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ ذِكْرِي، وَكُنْتُ فِي الْمَنْسِيِّينَ، كَمَنْ قَدْ نُسِيَ.
transliteration: mawlāya warḥamnī iżā inqaṭaʿa mina al-dunyā atharī waammahā mina al-makhlooqeen dhikree wa kuntu fil-mansiyīn, kaman qad nusiya
english_text: My Master, and have mercy upon me when my trace is cut off from this world, my mention is effaced among the creatures, and I join the forgotten, like the forgotten ones!

arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي عِنْدَ تَغَيُّرِ صُورَتِي وَحَالِي إذَا بَلِيَ جِسْمِي، وَتَفَرَّقَتْ أَعْضَائِي، وَتَقَطَّعَتْ أَوْصَالِيْ، يا غَفْلَتِي عَمَّا يُرَادُ بِيَ.
transliteration: mawlāya warḥamnī ʿinda taghayyuri ṣūratī waḥālī 'iḏā balīya jismī, wa tafarraqat 'aẓā'ī wa taqattaʿat awsālī, yā ghaflatī ʿammā yurādu bī
english_text: My Master, and have mercy upon me at the change of my form and state when my body decays, my limbs are scattered, and my joints are dismembered! O my heedlessness toward what was wanted from me!

arabic_text: مَوْلاَيَ وَارْحَمْنِي فِي حَشْرِي وَنَشْرِي، وَاجْعَل فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَومِ مَعَ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ مَوْقِفِي، وَفِي أَحِبَّائِكَ مَصْدَرِي، وَفِي جِوَارِكَ مَسْكَنِي يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
transliteration: mawlāy warḥamnī fī hašrī wa-našrī wa-jʿal fī dhālika al-yawm maʿa awliyāʾika mawqifī wa fī aḥibbā'ika maṣdari wa fī jiwarika maskanī yā rabb al-ʿālamīn
english_text: My Master, have mercy upon me at my mustering and uprising and on that day, appoint my standing place with Thy friends, my place of emergence with Thy beloveds, and my dwelling in Thy neighbourhood! O Lord of the worlds!
